title: Keep the decision reason
hook: “We chose B” does not preserve why B was chosen.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Record choice, constraint and reason together.

objective: Record choice, constraint and reason together.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: “We chose B” does not preserve why B was chosen. Which record allows the rationale to be inspected later? Correct option: Choice plus reason. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
